name: Between Sessions
tagline: Get more from therapy in the days between
about: Between Sessions helps you prepare for and debrief therapy, build the exposure ladders and activity schedules your therapist assigned, and decode any worksheet you've been handed.
persona: You are a psychologically literate homework buddy: you support the plan the user's therapist set, never replace it, and stay concrete and encouraging.

onboarding.title: Make the homework stick
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your therapy so the tools fit the approach.

tools.title: Prep my session
tools.subtitle: Don't waste the first ten minutes

inputs.label: Since last session
inputs.placeholder: had a panic on Tuesday, avoided the party, slept badly…

tools.prompt: Prepare for the next session from: {since}, plus the thing I keep not saying: {avoid}. Bullets of 3–5 agenda items ordered by importance, a kv (Wins, Setbacks, Questions for my therapist, Homework status), a quote with one sentence to open the session with the hard topic, and a callout reminding me it's fine to read from notes.

tools.title: Debrief a session
tools.subtitle: Capture it before it fades

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: we talked about my dad, she suggested tracking avoidance…

tools.prompt: Debrief this session: {notes}. Kv (Key insight, Thing that landed hard, Homework agreed, Question for next time), a checklist of the homework broken into small tickable tasks with a suggested day for each, and bullets on what to notice this week.

tools.title: Exposure ladder
tools.subtitle: Fear → ten rungs you can climb

inputs.label: The fear
inputs.placeholder: riding the tube at rush hour

tools.prompt: Build a graded exposure ladder for {fear}, starting from '{start}'. Table with exactly 10 rungs ordered easiest to hardest (Rung | Situation | Predicted anxiety 0–100 | Safety behaviour to drop | Repeat until), steps for how to run a single exposure (before, during and after ratings), and a callout on when to pause and check with the therapist.

tools.title: Activity schedule
tools.subtitle: Behavioural activation for a flat week
tools.prompt: Plan a behavioural-activation week with energy '{energy}' from these former joys: {enjoy}. Table (Day | Activity | Minutes | Type: pleasure / mastery / connection | Predicted enjoyment 0–10), bullets on how to shrink each activity if the day is bad, and a callout on rating actual enjoyment afterwards to compare with the prediction.

tools.title: Decode a worksheet
tools.subtitle: Photo → what it wants from you
tools.prompt: Explain the worksheet in the photo: text on what it's for and which approach it comes from, steps to fill it in with an example line for each field, a callout on common mistakes people make with it, and bullets of questions to ask the therapist if it doesn't fit.

disclaimer: Not therapy or medical advice. If you're in crisis or thinking about harming yourself or someone else, contact local emergency services or a crisis line now.
